program.openAccessNote: The solicitation calls for models, data sets, and tools to be openly accessible to the broadest possible range of users whenever possible, while recognizing that some projects may rely on proprietary data or tools that cannot be shared.
program.description: Through the NSF Directorate for Technology, Innovation and Partnerships, APTO advances the assessment of how investments in science and technology research and development lead to changes in technology capability, production, and use. Projects study past and possible future states, create models that can extend across technology areas, and develop evidence intended to improve R&D investment decisions and strengthen long-term U.S. competitiveness.

projects.officialTitle: APTO: A firm-level model of technological improvement, production and diffusion in the energy sector
projects.summary: Macrocosm is developing a data-driven, agent-based model of U.S. energy firms, their geolocated physical assets, and their interactions in local markets. The model is intended to explore feedbacks among technological improvement, investment, firm performance, infrastructure, and policy over the next two decades.

projects.officialTitle: APTO: Collaborative Research: Global Observatory and Virtual Laboratory for Science and Technology Advance
projects.summary: The University of Chicago team is creating a global observatory and virtual laboratory for science and technology. A chronologically trained language model will serve as a data-driven digital double of the global techno-scientific system, connecting research artifacts and metadata to measures of capability, production, and use and supporting simulated policy experiments and causal analysis.

projects.officialTitle: APTO: Constructing causal knowledge graphs for assessing and predicting technology outcomes
projects.summary: Insilicom is expanding its iKraph biomedical knowledge graph with technology entities and directed relationships drawn from publications, patents, reports, Wikipedia, and public databases. The team will also create an AI-assisted, end-to-end toolkit that APTO teams can use to extract information and construct domain knowledge graphs, including a case study in advanced manufacturing for generic drugs.

projects.officialTitle: APTO: Measuring, Understanding, Predicting, and Accelerating Technology Outcomes

people.name: Alicia I. Loffler
people.headshotAlt: Headshot placeholder for Alicia I. Loffler

projects.summary: Northwestern and its partners are building an integrated research-to-market data pipeline and predictive and causal models to measure, understand, predict, and accelerate technology outcomes. The work links university research and investment to disclosures, licensing, startups, and technology-specific measures across additive manufacturing, synthetic biology, advanced materials, AI algorithms, and therapeutics.

projects.officialTitle: APTO: Problem-Focused Analysis for Predicting Technology Outcomes and Leverage Points

funding.caveat: The NSF API currently reports funds obligated above the estimated total for this record; both values are shown exactly as published.

projects.summary: Aperture, the platform of Artemis Intelligence, is developing problem-focused datasets that connect technical needs with technologies and organizations across selected domains. The project will mine diverse evidence sources and compare statistical signals with expert and historical ground truth to identify predictive factors, hidden opportunities, promising partners, and high-leverage research or investment targets.
